title.narrative: Governance Progress Board for the Eastern Partnership Countries

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective of the Action is to contribute to strengthened good governance and rule of law in the Eastern Neighbourhood. 

The Specific Objective (Outcome) of the Action is to enhance the evidence-based policy through improved monitoring of good governance and rule of law reforms.

description.narrative: Development of a datadriven method to measure progress of Rule of Law and Good Governance based on European standards and relevant EU acquis for the five EaP countries. The datadriven method should analyze and cross validate existing data on governance performance (e.g. worldwide governance indicators of the Word bank or Council of Europe European Commission for the efficiency of justice, SDG Reporting) and setup a Good Governance Reporting mechanism for the EaP countries.

description.narrative: Development of a datadriven method to measure progress of Rule of Law and Good Governance based on European standards and relevant EU acquis for the five EaP countries. The datadriven method should analyze and cross validate existing data on governance performance (e.g. worldwide governance indicators of the Word bank or Council of Europe European Commission for the efficiency of justice, SDG Reporting) and setup a Good Governance Reporting mechanism for the EaP countries.

description.narrative: Good governance, the rule of law, and human rights are preconditions that must be in place in regard to EUs relationship with the governments of partner countries and of the EaP itself. They are preconditions for a stable democratic system, a functioning market economy and sustainable growth. Some progress has been achieved regarding the implementation of key judicial reforms in some partner countries, however more efforts are needed to be devoted to developing functioning judicial systems based on the principles of independence, accountability, impartiality, quality and efficiency of the judiciaryin line with European standards and Venice Commission recommendations on the rule of law and the judiciary. territorial, intgrant lapproche genre (urbain, rural) adoptent une approche base sur les lieux qui prend en compte le rle des communes (dans leur conception et leur mise en uvre).

title.narrative: (Indicator 2) Percentile ranking of Government effectiveness in Worldwide Governance indicator.

description.narrative: In an emerging deeper cooperation with the EUoriented Eastern Partnership states, progress towards the principles of good governance is essential. Large number of data sets, each with its own distinct methodology and showing only a limited part of the good governance dimensions are difficult to use for policy makers without further contextualisation and qualitative interpretation. The action will therefore bring together existing indices to measure progress across the wider good governance dimension in a digestible way for policy makers and civil society, bridging thematic and methodological barriers to the crosscomparison of data. The project will address the fact that a wide range of raw data on the EaP countries currently exists, without being analysed and compiled in a coherent way. The Progress Board therefore aims to set up a pilot method for good governance reporting which draws on and harmonises the results of existing data sources. The reports can be used for monitoring and analysis of progress in governance reforms, including in the context of EU accession.

title.narrative: (Indicator 1) Percentile ranking in the rule of law, Worldwide Governance indicator.

description.narrative: The Joint Communication Eastern Partnership policy beyond 2020 Reinforcing Resilience an Eastern Partnership that delivers for all specifically stresses that the EU will keep working together with the governments of partner countries to strengthen the rule of law and anticorruption mechanisms, as well as the independence, impartiality, efficiency, and accountability of justice systems. The Eastern Partnership Summit in December 2021 reaffirmed the importance of the rule of law, democracy, human rights and fundamental freedoms as cornerstones of the Eastern Partnership. Recent developments in the region have brought serious challenges to the rule of law and human rights. The very dynamic changes in all political systems of the EaP require tailormade support for the promotion of the rule of law and good governance.
